import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

# Define paths
input_dir = "input"
submission_dir = "submission"
train_path = f"{input_dir}/train.csv"
test_path = f"{input_dir}/test.csv"
sample_path = f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv"
submission_output = f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

# Load sample to understand correct submission format
sample_headers = sample_sub.columns.tolist()

# Get feature columns (all except Id and Cover_Type from training)
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "Id" and c != "Cover_Type"]

# Extract features and labels
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train_full = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_test_features = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df["Id"].values

# Create stratified train/validation split to maintain class proportions
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Train LightGBM with improved binning for better feature handling
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    max_depth=-1,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.0,
    reg_lambda=0.0,
    max_bin=256,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)
lgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on HOLDOUT validation set (not used in training)
val_preds = lgb_model.predict(X_val)
validation_acc = np.mean(val_preds == y_val)
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Accuracy: {validation_acc:.4f}")

# Predict on TEST set (this data never touched during training or validation)
test_preds = lgb_model.predict(X_test_features)

# Create submission dataframe with exact format from sample
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_ids.astype(str), "Cover_Type": test_preds.astype(int)}
)

# Sort by Id (typically required for consistent comparison)
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values("Id").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save to required location
submission_df.to_csv(submission_output, index=False)
print("Prediction saved successfully to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total rows submitted: {len(submission_df)}")

# Print validation metric
print(validation_acc)
